evidence.text: Conversational memory distils a single narrator's facts at ingest and loses the originals; organizational memory keeps every record from many authors and lets the question do the choosing

Mem++ is evaluated on **OrgMemBench**, a benchmark for organizational memory: 443 artifacts in
157 threads spanning 18 months, and 73 questions across six capabilities.

organizational_mechanism: At the initial release commit, Mem++ describes organizational memory as preserving every author record, keeping superseded/conflicting records instead of deleting them, and evaluating those mechanisms on OrgMemBench.
